title: react/react
claim: react/react — The library for web and native user interfaces.
why_good: Meta's UI library that runs the web — foundational infrastructure, not a founder opportunity.
value: No startup here; money around React is tooling/consulting, and Meta owns it.
risk: Owned by Meta, ubiquitous; a category signal, not a buildable opening.
